text_block_list.text:
With the Takarazuka Kinen now behind
her,
Сайленс Судзука buckles down for her
goal
race—the autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But until then, she spends her days
training in
preparation for her next
race—the Mainichi Okan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса and Грасс Вандер
eagerly wait
for their chance to race
against Сайленс Судзука.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They issue their challenge and promise
to meet
her at the starting gates of the
Mainichi Okan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
